fields.v: Evaluates; secondary: Compares — controlled experiments comparing 8 rule-file conditions vs a no-rule baseline, rule counts, rule types, per-rule ablation and superposition (>5,000 runs), plus repository mining: corpus analysis and taxonomy of 679 rule files (25,532 rules) scraped from GitHub
fields.quote: we scrape 679 rule files (25,532 rules) from GitHub and conduct over 5,000 agent runs of Claude Code with Claude Opus 4.6 on SWE-bench Verified.
fields.why: The value has two 'secondary:' entries and the second ('repository mining') is not one of the allowed nature values; the protocol allows one optional secondary and files repository mining under 'Evaluates'.
fields.doubt: O campo tem dois 'secondary:' e o segundo ('repository mining') não é um valor da lista do protocolo. A mineração de repositórios conta como 'Evaluates', que já é a natureza principal. Decide se juntas a mineração ao detalhe (como proposto) ou manténs o formato atual.

fields.v: Partly (0.5): paired tests (McNemar, Cochran's Q, sign test, Fisher, threshold sensitivity) and 3 seeds in Exp. 2, but single trajectory per task-condition in Exp. 1, 3 and 4, with baseline shift between experiments acknowledged
fields.quote: The no-rule baseline also differs between Experiment 1 (50.0%, single trajectory per task) and Experiment 2 (60.3%, averaged over three seeds)
fields.where: §7 Discussion, Limitations (Statistical power and baseline variance), p. 9
fields.why: Repetitions exist only in Exp. 2 (and screening); the other experiments use one trajectory per task-condition, and an equivalent design (single run plus statistical tests) was scored Partly elsewhere, so Yes may be generous.
fields.doubt: Só a Exp. 2 tem 3 sementes; as Exp. 1, 3 e 4 usam uma única execução por tarefa e condição (pág. 4-5, 9), e o próprio baseline muda de 50,0% para 60,3%. Há testes estatísticos. Decide entre Sim e Parcial, de forma coerente com outros estudos de execução única com testes.
